title: Reset MFA after phone loss
body: Users must contact identity-support with manager approval to reset MFA on Entra ID. Self-service reset is disabled for security reasons.

title: VPN troubleshooting for AnyConnect sleep/wake drops
body: Known issue with Windows modern standby. Workaround: disable fast startup and update AnyConnect to 4.10.08029 or later.

title: HR confidential document handling policy
body: Any ticket containing salary, PII, or compensation data must be escalated to hr-confidential and never shared outside that group.

title: Printer offline troubleshooting
body: Check print spooler service, reinstall driver, confirm printer is on corp VLAN not guest VLAN.

title: SharePoint permissions after tenant migration
body: Run the permission-remap script; most post-migration access issues are stale group SIDs, re-sync fixes within 15 minutes.

title: Battery swelling safety procedure
body: Do not charge a swollen battery. Isolate device, submit asset-safety ticket, desktop-support dispatches replacement same day.

title: Security incident escalation for credential attacks
body: Password spray or brute-force alerts go directly to security-ops; do not attempt remediation at tier-1.

title: Guest Wi-Fi known limitations
body: Guest SSID is rate-limited and blocks UDP media ports; Teams calls may drop. Direct guests to corp Wi-Fi with sponsor access when possible.

title: How to open a Contoso support ticket
body: Anyone can open a ticket at the Contoso support portal. Choose a severity, attach screenshots, and a tier-1 engineer responds within one business day. No account group membership is required to read this article.

title: Published support hours and severity definitions
body: Standard support runs 08:00 to 18:00 local time. Sev A means production down, Sev B means degraded, Sev C means question or request. These definitions are published publicly.
